description: Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha - Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha - Roads and Lanes
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the declaration and registration of roads and lanes as property owned by the Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha. It includes detailed schedules of road names, coordinates, lengths, and widths, and establishes legal ownership rights over these properties. The content focuses on land registration and property rights rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
